newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fell on fewer inquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fell on fewer inquiries.

text.p: Indian castor December delivery prices on Monday fell to 1,132/1,134 rupees per quintal from 1,140/1,142 on fresh speculative offerings, traders said.
"The absence of fresh enquiries from exporters as well as sliding edible oils prices triggered bull liquidation," one trader said.
Groundnut oil eased to 404/405 rupees per 10 kg from 414/415 rupees on the back of rising new crop arrivals. Buyers kept away expecting further price falls, the trader said.
Rajkot spot oil fell to 590/595 rupees per 15 kg from 620/625 rupees on unloading by stockists.
